text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Claiming victory in the Satsuki Sho is—
Dantsu Flame...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Seriously!? Not Pokke, not Tachyon,
but that girl—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Haha...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see, I see...!
Racing truly is endlessly fascinating!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Fweh.
N-N-No—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ehe, ehe, ehehehe~!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Both Tachyon-chan and Pokke-chan were there,
so, um, it still feels like a dream even now...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: There are still so many areas where I haven't caught up to the two of them, but—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Still, but, I'm so, so happy! Thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
As expected, will those two
be your rivals for the 'Japanese Derby' as well?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure both of them will become
much, much stronger than they are today!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"So that I won't lose,
I'll do my very best with all my might!"
And so, the Satsuki Sho came to a close with the best possible result—
A few weeks later, the incident occurred.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I, Agnes Tachyon,
am going on an indefinite hiatus from racing!

Agnes Tachyon made what was
essentially an announcement of her retirement.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"After stating as a preface that
'the leg trouble was merely an indirect cause'—"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "Stating she would observe the Umamusume who reach 'Truth,' she departed the press conference room."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Not Tachyon-chan, no...!

"This retirement announcement
sent massive shockwaves through every walk of life."

text_block_list.name: TV Personality
text_block_list.text:
"No, honestly, I was surprised... or rather,
it was quite a shock!"

text_block_list.name: TV Personality
text_block_list.text:
Her talent has been the talk of the town since her
debut, and I was truly looking forward to
seeing what she'd do next.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
My god has disappeared~!
Waaah~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Still, she's still enrolled at the academy, right? That means she hasn't been deregistered, so maybe she'll just pop back in out of the blue...

text_block_list.name: Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
The Agnes Tachyon Paka Puchi figures
are limited to two per customer!

text_block_list.name: Tachyon's Fan
text_block_list.text:
"B-But I really wanted to see Tachyon
run in the Nippon Derby...!!"

text_block_list.name: Social Media Voices
text_block_list.text:
"I'm in total shock" "No way"
"The Classic campaign just lost its main star"

text_block_list.name: Social Media Voices
text_block_list.text: "‘If only it were Agnes Tachyon, she would have definitely shown us the most magnificent view!’"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...They really are amazing...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I'm in shock about them being gone, too.
After all, we're classmates, friends,
and rivals..."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "Still, right now, the people who aren't are just as shocked."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: To have so much expected of me after just four races...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...If it were me, that would
surely have been impossible."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (I should have known.)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(Tachyon-chan is amazing.
She's far and away the most talented in our generation.)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(So after all, even if I won...
I couldn't win—)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Aah, jeez!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I can't afford to be timid.
After all, it's not like Tachyon-chan wanted to retire either.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I just have to keep moving forward...!
Doing everything that is within my power—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Stand at the top of our generation at the Japan Derby,
beat everyone, and then—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
And there—
I have to surpass Tachyon-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
If I can't even manage that much,
I'll never be able to become the main star going forward!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (The 'Japanese Derby'... The one who'll stand in my way is surely—)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Alright...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Pokke-chan!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry, but I'm in a foul mood right now.
If you wanna run, how about we do it tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Counting on you for the Nippon Derby...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I will win, no matter what.
Against Pokke-chan... against everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
S-So yeah!
That's how it is, see you tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...What's with her, all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: “Counting on you for the Nippon Derby,” huh—

"Shaking off the vivid brilliance
left behind by Agnes Tachyon,
I'll definitely reach the center stage in our next race, the Japanese Derby!"
